thought.text: The JSON got corrupted. Let me restore and try a different approach - fetch fresh from GitHub:

reasoning_content: The sed command broke the package.json. Let me restore from a backup or fetch a fresh copy from GitHub.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

print("=== Restoring from Backup ===")

# Use .env.bak or restore from original
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/package.json* | head -10")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Restore from backup
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cp /opt/areloria/.env.bak /opt/areloria/package.json 2>/dev/null || cp /root/opt/areloria/package.json /opt/areloria/package.json 2>/dev/null")
print("Tried to restore")

# Or just clone fresh from GitHub
print("\n=== Cloning Fresh from GitHub ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt && rm -rf areloria_new && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/OuroborosCollective/Wasd.git areloria_new 2>&1 | tail -10")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
PYEOF
